defs.def: to carry sth; to have sb/sth in your hand, arms, etc. 拿着；抓住；抱住；托住；夹着

ex.s: The card holder has changed his or her major.
ex.t: 卡的主人更改了他或她的专业。

ex.s: Traditions hold much value for them.
ex.t: 传统对他们来说极具价值。

ex.s: You must leave right now!” he called out, holding the branch with both hands.
ex.t: “你必须现在就离开！”他双手抓着树枝喊道。

ex.s: Holding hands in the freezing lake, we looked out for each other last winter and will do so through this one.
ex.t: 在冰冷的湖里握手,我们去年冬天互相照顾, 并且会通过这个湖来这样做。

ex.s: Tightly holding the permission slip from the orchestra director, I ran all the way home after school, and shakily handed it to my parents with a fear that they might dismiss my desire.
ex.t: 紧紧攥着管弦乐队指挥的许可条，放学后我一溜烟跑回家，颤抖着递给父母，生怕他们会否决我的愿望。

ex.s: It breaks the food before holding it.
ex.t: 它在拿起食物前会弄碎它。

defs.def: to put your hand on part of your body, usually because it hurts 抱住，捂住，按住（受伤的身体部位等）
to keep sb/sth in a particular position 使保持（在某位置）
to support the weight of sb/sth 支撑 … 的重量
to have enough space for sth/sb; to contain sth/sb 容纳；包含

ex.s: How many people could the Circus Maximus hold?
ex.t: 大竞技场（Circus Maximus）能容纳多少人？

defs.def: to keep sb and not allow them to leave 监禁；拘留

ex.s: So for them to move to Elkhead, Colo. to instruct the children whose shoes were held together with string was a surprise.
ex.t: 因此，她们搬到科罗拉多州埃尔克黑德，去教那些鞋子用绳子绑在一起的孩子，令人意外。

defs.def: to defend sth against attack; to have control of sth 守卫；控制
to remain strong and safe or in position 承受住；坚持住；保持原位
to remain the same 保持不变
to keep sb's attention or interest 使（注意力或兴趣）持续不减；吸引住

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

ex.s: They can hold students' attention.
ex.t: 它们能吸引学生的注意力。

ex.s: The results held true even after the scientists accounted for the participants’ overall health status.
ex.t: 即使在科学家对参与者的总体健康状况作了说明之后,结果还是真实的。

defs.def: to keep sth at the same level, rate, speed, etc. 使保持同样程度（或比率、速度等）
to keep sth so that it can be used later 保存；存贮

ex.s: I looked pointedly at the bookshelf that held at least three dictionaries, and Kevin sighed dramatically.
ex.t: 我特意看了看那个至少放着三本词典的书架，凯文夸张地叹了口气。

defs.def: to own or have sth 拥有；持有

ex.s: Companies could be forced to consumers what information they hold and how many money they make form it.
ex.t: 公司可能被迫向消费者披露它们持有哪些信息以及从中获利多少。

ex.s: hold a master's degree in science
ex.t: 持有理学硕士学位

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他持有客观现实存在的观念，但他说我们的心智在构建和塑造我们的感知中扮演着必要的角色。

ex.s: A college holds the key to success.
ex.t: 大学掌握着成功的关键。

ex.s: ALife holds the key to human future.
ex.t: ALife掌握着人类未来的关键。

defs.def: to have a particular job or position 担任；任职
to have sth you have gained or achieved 获得；赢得
to have a belief or an opinion about sb/sth 怀有，持有（信念、意见）

ex.s: I held presentations at schools to teach kids about plastic waste.
ex.t: 我在学校做了演讲教孩子们关于塑料废物的知识。

defs.def: to consider that sth is true 认为；相信
to have a meeting, competition, conversation, etc. 召开；举行；进行

ex.s: The three-day Ludlow Food Festival is held each September.
ex.t: 为期三天的拉德洛美食节每年九月举行。

ex.s: The WHO-China Joint Mission on Covid-19 held a press conference.
ex.t: 世界卫生组织—中国新冠病毒联合专家组举行了新闻发布会。

ex.s: Where was Open Tchaikovsky Competition held in 1986?
ex.t: 1986年柴可夫斯基公开赛在哪里举行？

ex.s: 17 Where was Open Tchaikovsky Competition held in 1986?
ex.t: 17 1986年柴可夫斯基公开赛在哪里举行？

ex.s: We’ll hold a lantern riddles competition, too.
ex.t: 我们也会举办灯笼谜比赛。

ex.s: A housewarming party is a special party to be held when someone buys or moves into a new apartment or house.
ex.t: 暖房派对是当有人购买或搬进新公寓或新房时举办的特殊派对。

ex.s: We will be holding a free taster session on 23rd May, at 10 am, to demonstrate the variety of effective and active exercises.
ex.t: 我们将于5月23日上午10点举办一场免费体验课，展示各种有效且活跃的锻炼方式。

ex.s: Nowadays, more and more countries around the world are holding celebrations for Chinese Spring Festival.
ex.t: 如今，世界上越来越多的国家为中国春节举办庆祝活动。

ex.s: Selected from collections throughout the world, it is the first major exhibition of his work to be held in over forty years.
ex.t: 这些作品选自世界各地收藏，这是四十多年来首次举办他的作品大型展览。

ex.s: To hold an audition.
ex.t: 举行一场试镜。

ex.s: Hold a dinner party.
ex.t: 举办一场晚宴。

ex.s: Holding a press conference.
ex.t: 在举行新闻发布会。

ex.s: We will email you if a place becomes available or if a new session is to be held.
ex.t: 如果有名额空出或要举办新活动，我们会给你发邮件。

ex.s: Hold a clothing swap
ex.t: 举办一次衣物交换

ex.s: Libraries will often hold reading-group sessions targeted to various age groups.
ex.t: 图书馆经常会举办针对不同年龄段的阅读小组活动。

defs.def: to be in close contact with the road and easy to control, especially when driven fast 机动车

ex.s: In 1870, when Dickens died, the world mourned him as its first professional writer and publisher, famous and beloved, who had led an explosion in both the publication of novels and their readership and whose characters — from Oliver Twist to Tiny Tim— were held up as moral touchstones.
ex.t: 1870年狄更斯去世时，世界哀悼这位首位职业作家和出版人，他声名显赫、深受爱戴，引领了小说出版与读者群的爆发式增长，其笔下人物——从奥利弗·崔斯特到小蒂姆——被视为道德试金石。

defs.def: to continue to move in a particular direction 船或飞机
to make a note continue for a particular time 延长，继续唱（某音符）

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

defs.def: to wait until you can speak to the person you have telephoned （打电话时）等待，不挂断

ex.s: I watched with great sympathy as elderly Italians tried to hold a conversation in Italian with people who did not speak the language.
ex.t: 我满怀同情地看着年长的意大利人试图用意大利语与不懂这门语言的人交谈。

defs.def: 停下；不要做
to prevent sb/sth from moving forward or crossing sth 拦阻；阻挡
to prevent the progress or development of sb/sth 妨碍进展
to not tell sb sth they want or need to know 不向（某人）透露情况；隐瞒

ex.s: They are held in the Lecture Room.
ex.t: 它们在报告厅展出。

ex.s: They held hands, shouting and yelling into the sky.
ex.t: 他们手拉着手，对着天空大喊大叫。

defs.def: to stop yourself from expressing how you really feel 抑制，控制（感情等）；不露声色
to prevent sb from moving, using force 按住某人
to prevent sb from having their freedom or rights 剥夺某人的自由（或权利）

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

defs.def: to keep sth at a low level 使保持低水平
to keep a job for some time 保住（工作、职位）

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装一个袋子、切一块蛋糕、猜猜哪个果汁容器装的水最多，还有很多其他活动。

ex.s: Staff members hold plenty of bar events for guests like free shots, bar crawls and karaoke.
ex.t: 工作人员为客人举办很多酒吧活动，如免费酒水、酒吧巡游和卡拉OK。

ex.s: So, being an adult isn’t just holding a job.
ex.t: 所以，成为成年人不仅仅是有一份工作。

defs.def: to limit sth, especially a noise 限制（尤指噪音）
to not start 雨或风暴
to not do sth immediately 推迟
等着；停住

ex.s: While still holding the camera to my eye, I turned slowly...then stopped still.
ex.t: 仍把相机贴在眼前，我缓缓转过身……然后静止不动。

defs.def: to survive in a difficult or dangerous situation （在困境或危险中）坚持住，挺住
（电话用语）别挂断，等一下

ex.s: Picture this: my grandson sitting on my lap as I hold the book in front so he can see the pictures.
ex.t: 想象一下：我的孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前让他看到图片。

defs.def: to keep sth that is an advantage for you; to not give or sell sth to sb else 保住（优势）；不送（或不卖）某物
to keep sth for sb else or for longer than usual （替别人或更长时间地）保存某物

ex.s: Snack periods are held throughout the day.
ex.t: 全天都有加餐时间。

defs.def: to last, especially in a difficult situation 维持；坚持
to resist or survive in a dangerous or difficult situation 抵抗；幸存
to not deal with sth immediately; to leave sth to be dealt with later 搁置；推迟
to show a film/movie, play, etc. for longer than planned 延长（电影、戏剧等）的上演期
to make sb keep a promise 要求某人遵守诺言
to stop an opposing team scoring more points, etc. than you 压住对方；不让对方的（得分等）超过己方
to remain, or to keep sth, united （使）保持团结
to be logical or consistent 论点、理论或故事
if a machine or an object holds together or sth holds it together, the different parts stay together so that it does not break （机器、物品）完好无损

ex.s: Credibility holds the key to development.
ex.t: 信誉是发展的关键。

defs.def: to support sb/sth and stop them from falling 搀扶；支撑；举起；抬起

ex.s: Interviewer: So, hold your head up, then.
ex.t: 采访者：那么，抬起头来吧。

defs.def: to delay or block the movement or progress of sb/sth 延迟；阻碍

ex.s: Thematic ones hold back change.
ex.t: 主题性的会阻碍变化。

ex.s: If an overweight person is having a large portion, I’ll hold back a bit because I see the results of his eating habits.
ex.t: 如果一个超重的人拿了大份，我会稍微克制，因为我看到了他的饮食习惯带来的结果。

ex.s: I felt he treated me as though I would hold him back and probably make him fail to get an A in the course.
ex.t: 我觉得他对待我，就好像我会拖他后腿，并可能让他在这门课上拿不到A。

defs.def: to use or present sb/sth as an example 举出（例子）；提出（作为榜样）

ex.s: Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明，如果一场争论得到解决，与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少，或几乎完全消除。因此，与其压抑，不如与朋友、家人或同学把问题提出来，可能最终会有更好的结果。

defs.def: the action of holding sb/sth; the way you are holding sb/sth 抓；握；拿；支撑
a particular way of holding sb, especially in a sport such as wrestling or in a fight 持；握；抓；抱；（尤指摔跤、拳击中的）擒拿法
influence, power or control over sb/sth 影响；左右力；控制
a place where you can put your hands or feet when climbing 支撑点（可手攀或脚踏的地方）
the part of a ship or plane where the goods being carried are stored 货舱
to find sth that you want or need 找到所需要的东西

ex.s: 34 On this day every year, countries around the world hold events to educate people about the problems of dirty water and that clean water is something that everyone should have around the world.
ex.t: 34 每年的这一天，世界各国举办活动，教育人们关于污水的问题，以及清洁的水是全世界每个人都应有的东西。

defs.def: to learn or understand sth 学会；理解
delayed until a later time or date 推迟；中断
if a person on the telephone is put on hold, they have to wait until the person that they want to talk to is free （电话接通后）等某人接电话
